nominated_text: Strong in-domain performance does not guarantee unseen-element chemical transfer.
prospective_or_retrospective: prospective for the Ni term; in-domain for the reference
supporting_metric: x_partition mean TVD, identical metric definition in both stages
allowed_wording: Strong in-domain performance does not guarantee unseen-element chemical transfer: the same frozen pipeline that reaches a mean X-partition TVD of 0.001640 on the in-domain test scores 0.864386 on a prospectively held-out chemical identity, worse than its own training-mean baseline (0.595767).
forbidden_overclaim: Do not write that the model is an accurate zero-shot unseen-element model, or that this demonstrates universal OOD generalization.

claim_text: Marginal feature-range overlap is insufficient for thermodynamic transfer: none of the 43 production features extends beyond its training range on any Ni state, no Ni state has any |z| above 5, and Ni's elemental descriptor vector lies inside the six training identities' property ranges - yet the prospective zero-shot TVD is 0.864386 against a trivial baseline of 0.595767. The range diagnostic was frozen before any Ni CALPHAD state existed.

supporting_metric: 0 of 43 features extending the training range; 0.0% of states with any |z|>5
allowed_wording: Marginal feature-range overlap is insufficient for thermodynamic transfer: none of the 43 production features extends beyond its training range on any Ni state, no Ni state has any |z| above 5, and Ni's elemental descriptor vector lies inside the six training identities' property ranges - yet the prospective zero-shot TVD is 0.864386 against a trivial baseline of 0.595767. claim_text: The dominant zero-shot failure is topology selection rather than small continuous partition error: the true Ni X-partition is 71.7% FCC-dominant and 28.3% OTHER_SOLID-dominant with no C15-dominant state at all, while the frozen model assigns C15 as the dominant family to 87.3% of states and reaches a topology accuracy of 0.0786.
nominated_text: The dominant zero-shot failure is topology selection rather than small continuous partition error.
supporting_metric: true and predicted dominant-family distributions; topology accuracy
allowed_wording: The dominant zero-shot failure is topology selection rather than small continuous partition error: the true Ni X-partition is 71.7% FCC-dominant and 28.3% OTHER_SOLID-dominant with no C15-dominant state at all, while the frozen model assigns C15 as the dominant family to 87.3% of states and reaches a topology accuracy of 0.0786.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not write that NBNI3 causes all error: the topology error is present across the whole temperature range, including the 700-1000 degC window where NBNI3 never appears.

nominated_text: Broader chemical-identity augmentation improves but does not solve unseen-element zero-shot transfer.
supporting_metric: PRIMARY and SECONDARY mean TVD and topology accuracy on the identical 22,000 states
allowed_wording: Broader chemical-identity augmentation improves but does not solve unseen-element zero-shot transfer: adding five further chemical identities lowers the prospective Ni TVD from 0.864386 to 0.723441 (16.3% lower) and raises topology accuracy from 0.0786 to 0.2407, yet the augmented model remains worse than its own training-mean baseline (0.723441 vs 0.525831).
forbidden_overclaim: Do not write that FULL11 solves chemical OOD. It was also declared SECONDARY before the reveal and cannot be promoted on the strength of this result.

claim_text: Minimal same-element thermodynamic anchoring rapidly restores transfer: a single Ni composition - which is 11 CALPHAD temperature states, not one data point - lowers the mean TVD on the held-out recovery subset from 0.863260 to 0.248162, a 71.3% reduction, already below the trivial baseline of 0.596019. Both preregistered budget thresholds are reached at the smallest budget tested (B_skill = 1, B_recovery25 = 1).
nominated_text: Minimal same-element thermodynamic anchoring rapidly restores transfer.
supporting_metric: mean TVD over 3 frozen random replicates on the 15,400-state recovery subset
allowed_wording: Minimal same-element thermodynamic anchoring rapidly restores transfer: a single Ni composition - which is 11 CALPHAD temperature states, not one data point - lowers the mean TVD on the held-out recovery subset from 0.863260 to 0.248162, a 71.3% reduction, already below the trivial baseline of 0.596019. allowed_wording: Few-shot recovery repairs the previous topology-selection failure: topology accuracy on the recovery subset rises from 0.0797 under the frozen zero-shot model to 0.7224 at 1 composition, 0.9158 at 2, 0.9433 at 4, 0.9750 at 8 and 0.9863 at 32.

claim_text: Ni-specific NBNI3 / OTHER_SOLID thermodynamics marks the hardest recovery regime: at 32 anchors the NBNI3-present stratum retains the highest residual TVD (0.036934) against 0.020935 for NBNI3-absent states, and the true-OTHER_SOLID stratum (0.031113) sits above the true-FCC stratum (0.025630). All four are far below the shared trivial baseline of 0.596019, so this is a relative ordering among well-recovered strata, not a residual failure. The pooled rank correlation of 0.7597 between anchor NBNI3 coverage and recovery magnitude is NOT usable evidence because it is confounded with budget size: every calibration composition contains at least one NBNI3 state, so the anchor coverage count is exactly the budget (rank correlation with budget = 1.0000), and the fraction-based coverage also rises with budget. Within a budget only 3 cells exist and most within-budget correlations are undefined or non-significant.
